Manage project memory
Claude regenerates project memory every evening from your past chats in this project. Only you can see this memory, and it is not shared with other project users.

Purpose & context

Kushal (GitHub: kusl) is building "MyRestaurant" — a self-hosted, single-restaurant ordering system intended for public release under AGPL-3.0. The project is a greenfield .NET 10 Blazor Server application with a strict, spec-first engineering discipline: behavior changes, requirement edits, spec edits, ADR edits, and documentation updates must all land together.

Stack & architecture:

.NET 10 Blazor Server (interactive-server mode), PostgreSQL with Dapper only (EF Core explicitly forbidden), DbUp startup migrations, rootless Podman Compose, OpenTelemetry with OTLP export
ASP.NET Core Identity with custom Dapper stores, Argon2id password hashing, .NET 10 built-in WebAuthn passkeys, TOTP with recovery codes
Strict dependency direction: WebApplication → DataAccess → Domain (Domain is BCL-only)
AGPL-3.0-only licensing; no paid dependencies
Local repo: /home/kushal/src/dotnet/myrestaurant; GitHub: github.com/kusl/myrestaurant (main branch)
Development environment: Fedora 44, testing on iPhone SE 2020, rootless Podman
Key constraints:

No .NET SDK in Claude's sandbox — all C# is written to spec and compiled by Kushal; Razor components are the most likely site for compiler-caught issues
No EF Core, no Redis (unless proven necessary), no Moq, no FluentAssertions (use AwesomeAssertions), no prerelease packages
GitHub PAT is available for read-only API calls but must never appear in any response or generated file
xUnit v3 with Testcontainers (real PostgreSQL, not mocks); Playwright E2E deferred to M6
.slnx format exclusively; never regenerate .sln
Six-milestone plan:

M1 (complete): Skeleton, pure Domain, DataAccess, WebApplication host, infra, tests, scripts
M2 (in progress): Identity and accounts — Dapper Identity stores, Argon2id, passkeys, TOTP, obligations middleware, /setup bootstrap, account administration
M3: Table CRUD, display pairing, rotating token endpoints, sittings/membership
M4: Living order with row-level locking, staging UI, batch send, fulfillment/reversal, kitchen surface
M5: Billing, counter, administration, menu management
M6: Playwright E2E, backup/restore drill, CI
Key people & references:

GoTunnels project (github.com/kusl/gotunnels) is the reference implementation for tunnels, WebAuthn, Argon2id, TOTP, and OTel patterns (but not its localStorage bearer session model)

Key learnings & principles

Dapper + Npgsql type binding: Npgsql materializes timestamptz as DateTime, not DateTimeOffset. Dapper's constructor binding (used for positional records) is strict about type matching; property-setter binding (used for classes) is more lenient. Fix pattern: introduce an internal row type with DateTime fields, project to the public record in a ToSummary() method. Avoid a global type handler to minimize blast radius.
WebAuthn RP-ID: Setting IdentityPasskeyOptions.ServerDomain = null enables per-request RP-ID derivation (ServerDomain ?? Request.Host.Host), which is how .NET 10's PasskeyHandler works natively. Quick tunnels work with this approach; pinning to a boot-time host does not.
AddIdentityCore vs AddIdentity: AddIdentityCore does not register IPasskeyHandler<TUser>; AddIdentity does. PasskeySignInAsync bypasses two-factor authentication by construction (bypassTwoFactor: true).
WebAuthn column requirements: The passkey_credential table must include is_backup_eligible and related boolean columns; the assertion handler reads and validates these bits.
Missing RestaurantClaimsPrincipalFactory: AddIdentityCore's default factory emits no role claims, meaning area policies could never pass. A custom ClaimsPrincipalFactory is required.
Stale container pitfall: Many apparent routing/404 issues are caused by running a stale container predating a code change. Full no-cache rebuild required.
compose.yaml profile interpolation: Podman-compose interpolates all services at parse time regardless of active profile; :? fail-fast guards on production-only variables abort dev commands. Use :- (empty default) instead.
IdentityWiringTests.cs project placement: Must live in MyRestaurant.WebApplication.Tests (not DataAccess.Tests); it references WebApplication-layer types. The .csproj requires explicit ProjectReference entries — no transitive reliance.
Framework API verification discipline: All .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core API signatures, property names, and member names are verified against dotnet/aspnetcore release/10.0 source via GitHub API before use, since no SDK is available in the sandbox.
Approach & patterns

Deliverable format (must be honored in every session):

Full file contents at exact repo-relative paths — never diffs or patches
Structured .tar.gz extracting at repo root for drop-in merge
Explicit statement of any files to delete
Minimal prose; immediate resumption on "please continue" without preamble
GitHub PAT must never appear in any response
Fix vs. continue policy: If a fix is small, fold it into the next feature slice output. If a fix is substantial, focus only on the current issue before advancing — avoid accumulating broken or unstable code.

Slice discipline: Each slice must leave the tree in a buildable, green state before the next slice begins. If a build is not confirmed green, hold the next slice.

Code patterns:

One connection and transaction per operation; single IClock.UtcNow instant per operation
UUIDv7 primary keys; snake_case unabbreviated identifiers throughout
Batched security_event inserts; security-stamp rotation on every credential/role/active-state change
BUILD_PROGRESS.md updated with each slice (append manually or request targeted diff — do not regenerate as a full file due to size)
Static-SSR Razor pages for administration surfaces; interactive-server mode for the main app
Testcontainers integration tests with a PostgreSqlFixture; skip-guarded when container runtime unavailable
Repo tooling:

export.sh generates dump.txt (concatenated LLM-readable repo dump); Claude navigates it via grep "^# FILE: " + sed -n to extract specific files
Transcript files stored at /mnt/transcripts/; repo dump at /mnt/project/dump.txt
run.sh is compose-up-and-watch (foreground); quick tunnels are a separate scripts/quick_tunnel.sh — these are always two separate commands
bash -n + shellcheck before delivering any shell script
Tools & resources

GitHub API (read-only, authenticated with PAT): used to verify framework source and fetch library signatures — never printed in responses
dotnet/aspnetcore release/10.0 on GitHub: authoritative source for .NET 10 API verification
Podman/Podman Compose: rootless container engine (not Docker); socket must be user-enabled
DbUp: startup migration runner (LogToConsole() preferred over custom IUpgradeLog)
OpenTelemetry: OTLP export; UPTRACE_DSN is optional
Net.Codecrete.QrCodeGenerator 3.0.0: inline SVG QR code generation
Konscious.Security.Cryptography (Argon2id), pinned in Directory.Packages.props
Cloudflare tunnels: named tunnel for production (stable origin for passkey RP-ID binding); quick tunnels for demo only (work with per-request RP-ID derivation)
